name: workslop-detector
description: Detects internal work that offloads thinking onto the reader.

interface.shortDescription: Find the work someone left for the reader.
interface.longDescription: Compares an internal document with blinded responses to the same assignment, tests cold-reader burden, and drafts a funny or serious reply.
defaultPrompt: Check this internal document for workslop.
What human judgment does this add beyond the assignment?
Give me a funny and a serious reply to send back.
